title: xLifestealCore
description: Everything You Need to Run a Competitive Lifesteal Server
body:
## ❤️ Why xLifeStealCore?

xLifeStealCore provides a complete LifeSteal experience with heart stealing, heart withdrawal, player elimination, revival mechanics, statistics, and powerful admin tools. Built for performance and designed for both small SMPs and large networks, it offers everything needed to run a modern LifeSteal server.

**Documentation** : https://xlifestealcore-docs.netlify.app/

### Player Commands

| Command              | Description                                   | Permission          |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| `/hearts`            | View your current heart status                | `xlifesteal.player` |
| `/withdraw <amount>` | Convert your hearts into physical heart items | `xlifesteal.player` |
| `/ls top`            | View the server heart leaderboard             | `xlifesteal.player` |
| `/revive <player>`   | Revive an eliminated player                   | `xlifesteal.player` |
| `/ls recipe`         | View the heart crafting recipe                | `xlifesteal.player` |

### Admin Commands

| Command                                | Description                                   | Permission         |
| -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| `/ls admin set <player> <amount>`      | Set a player's exact heart count              | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin add <player> <amount>`      | Add hearts to a player                        | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin remove <player> <amount>`   | Remove hearts from a player                   | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin give <player> <amount>`     | Give physical heart items to a player         | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin reset <player>`             | Reset a player's hearts to default            | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin ban <player>`               | Manually eliminate a player                   | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin unban <player>`             | Unban and revive a player                     | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin setmax <player> <amount>`   | Set a player's maximum hearts                 | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin setcap <amount>`            | Set the global heart cap                      | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin recipe <on/off>`            | Enable or disable heart crafting              | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin hearttype <type>`           | Change heart system type (Physical/Virtual)   | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin checkhearts <player>`       | Check a player's heart information            | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin reload`                     | Reload all plugin configurations              | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin wipe`                       | Reset all player data (confirmation required) | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin reviveall`                  | Revive all eliminated players                 | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin giveall <amount>`           | Give hearts to all online players             | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin setdropchance <percentage>` | Set heart drop chance on kills                | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin revivecost <amount>`        | Set the revive cost                           | `xlifesteal.admin` |
| `/ls admin heartitem <material>`       | Set the physical heart item material          | `xlifesteal.admin` |

---

## Permissions

| Permission                       | Description                                          | Default |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `xlifesteal.player`              | Access to all player commands                        | True    |
| `xlifesteal.admin`               | Full access to all admin commands and bypasses       | OP      |
| `xlifesteal.deathtime.<seconds>` | Set custom elimination duration for specific players | None    |

---

## PlaceholderAPI Placeholders

| Placeholder                | Description                                   |
| -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `%xlifesteal_hearts%`      | Displays the player's current heart count     |
| `%xlifesteal_heartscap%`   | Displays the player's maximum possible hearts |
| `%xlifesteal_top_1_name%`  | Displays the #1 player on the leaderboard     |
| `%xlifesteal_top_1_value%` | Displays the heart count of the #1 player     |
